messages.text: In on a different device. I asked earlier about how many algo the device can do at a time and JD was gonna get back to you

Hey Ty. Nothing back from JD yet — the pool-slot question is still open with him, and his answer lands right in this window plus your email.

Anything else I can dig into while you wait?
Is it raining there? I just mowed the lawn and I'm wiped out.

No weather out of me, Ty — I'm just the shop chat. Sounds like you earned the sit-down though.

Go get some water. JD's answer will be sitting here when you're ready.
Do you have a 50 unit discount on the hs15?
Handed to the team · Bulk quote and discount request — not mine to price.

Nothing I can give on price — the listed price is the price for me. But 50 units is a Georges conversation, and I've put it in front of him.

He'll pick it up right here; stay in the chat if you can, otherwise it comes by email.

Worth saying: the H15 isn't buyable yet, no drop date announced.
Let me reword that, do you have a 50 unit discount on the hs15?

Same answer, Ty — I don't have a bulk price to give on the H15 or anything else. That's Georges's call, and he's got it.

He'll come into this chat with it.

Anytime, Ty.

One thing I'm curious about: last we talked you were dialling units back on a tight budget, and now you're asking about fifty H15s. What changed — is that for you, or are you buying for someone else?
I moderate several channels, and I could talk to red panda mining and his other mods. Maybe they want a group buy. They would have to be shipped in lots to the different people

That changes it — a group buy with lots split to different addresses is exactly what Georges handles directly. I've added it to what's in front of him.

He'll come into this chat with it, and by email if you've stepped away.
Handed to the team · Bulk request changed: group buy, ~50 H15 units split-shipped to multiple address
